arguments.prompt: Wide establishing shot of the square outside New Harnomy City Hall at first light on a cold November morning. The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move at all: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no drift, no handheld shake. Real-time speed, natural human movement, never slow motion. The only movement is small and human: a handful of pedestrians in winter coats walk slowly across the granite paving at a distance with their backs to the camera, a dog-walker crosses, a cyclist rolls slowly past, steam rises from the hot-food cart. Every car stays parked exactly where it is; the flatbed lumber truck and the white box van stand still with their engines off; the bus at the far corner is stopped. The mauve banner on the portico stirs very slightly in a light wind. Long low winter sun, long shadows, frost on the paving. Prestige political drama photographed on an Arri Alexa with anamorphic lenses: single-source natural light, slight 35mm film grain, colours desaturated about twelve percent, warm tungstens, deep browns and charcoals in the shadows, photographic realism.
